name: Smallmouth bass
description:
Micropterus dolomieu, або малоротий окунь, — це вид прісноводних риб із родини центрахових (Centrarchidae), що є рідним для Північної Америки.
Опис:
Розмір: Дорослі особини зазвичай досягають 30–50 см у довжину, а їхня вага може сягати 2–4 кг, хоча трапляються і більші екземпляри.
Забарвлення: Колір варіюється від зеленувато-коричневого до бронзового, із темними вертикальними смугами на боках. Черево зазвичай світліше.
Голова: Характеризується відносно невеликим ротом, який не заходить за задній край ока (на відміну від великоротого окуня).
Поширення та середовище існування:
Природно поширений у східній частині Північної Америки, у річках, озерах і струмках із чистою водою, багатою на кисень.
Віддає перевагу водоймам із кам'янистим або піщаним дном.
Харчування:
Є хижаком, живиться дрібною рибою, ракоподібними, комахами та їхніми личинками.

name: Seadevil with parasitic male, Ceratiidae
description:
A fluid preserved female Triplewart seadevil, *Cryptopsaras couesii*, with an attached parasitic male from the Florida Museum of Natural History Ichthyology Collection (UF 167357). Males attach themselves to larger females during breeding. The male becomes a “sexual parasite,” hanging on for the rest of his life and unable to free himself, fertilizing the eggs produced by the female.

Order:  Lophiiformes

Family: Ceratiidae

Photogrammetry scan by the Florida Museum Digital Imaging division. https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/digital-lab/photogrammetry/

Collection info for this specimen can be found here: (http://specifyportal.flmnh.ufl.edu/fishes/). Search “167357” for catalog number.

Ichthyology Collection: https://www.floridamuseum.ufl.edu/fish/

Model is available for download on MorphoSource: https://n2t.net/ark:/87602/m4/806544

description:
Anatomical attributes that differentiate the scapula of common large sized mammals found in Australian archaeological sites.

Cow scapula from the University of Queensland Archaeology Laboratories digitised by structured light surface scan. Digitisation funded by Ozboneviz, an ARC Centre of Excellence for Australian Biodiversity and Heritage project.

Mule scapula from the collection of the [Idaho Museum of Natural History](http://www.isu.edu/imnh) digitised by laser surface scan. Digitisation funded by Rick Carron Foundation.

Original data available on MorphoSource:

* Domestic cow (UQ-208) [ark:/87602/m4/449538](http://n2t.net/ark:/87602/m4/449538)
* Domestic mule (IMNH-R191) [ark:/87602/m4/M105537](http://n2t.net/ark:/87602/m4/M105537)

Scale bars by Mikhail Antonov, 2022. *Photo scales & rulers (low poly)* CC BY 4.0.

name: Screeny
description:
# Meet *Screeny* !

***Screeny*** is a character I also made that is:

* Armless *[1]*

* Bodyless *[2]*

* Connectable

> *[1]* See **[this link](http://sketchfab.com/3d-models/kroby-the-robot-c24e5443b8af4844aebc6c907f1caa5e)** on *[1]* for more information on armless characters.

> *[2]* **Bodyless characters** are characters that don't have a body.

***Screeny*** has only a screen that can display ASCII characters.

# For example:

**Eyes:**

●: Neutral

⯋: Bored

⯋; Rotated Left & Right: Angry

⯋; Rotated Right & Left: Sad

⯊: Happy

\> & <: Shock

● & < / \> & ●: Winking

**Mouth:**

*Smile:*

v: Closed

▼: Open

*Frown:*

ʌ: Closed

▲: Open

*Neutral:*

•: O Shape

***Screeny*** also is connectable to their connections.

# For example:

If ***Screeny*** wants to be a quadruped, ***Screeny*** will need atleast 1 connection, because connections have 2 legs also.
If ***Screeny*** wants to be like a spider, ***Screeny*** will need 3 connections.

*(I used Vee's GLB file for the legs.)*

No ring, maps and no UVW mapping is available.

name: Bigfin squid
description:
Bigfin squids are a group of rarely seen cephalopods with a distinctive morphology. They are placed in the genus Magnapinna and family Magnapinnidae. Although the family was described only from larval, paralarval, and juvenile specimens, numerous video observations of much larger squid with similar morphology are assumed to be adult specimens of the same family.

The arms and tentacles of the squid are both extremely long, estimated at 4 to 8 m (13 to 26 ft). These appendages are held perpendicular to the body, creating "elbows". How the squid feeds is yet to be discovered.

Magnapinna is thought to be the deepest-occurring squid genus, with sightings as deep as 6,212 metres (20,381 ft) below the surface, making it the only squid known to inhabit the hadal zone.

Learn more at: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bigfin_squid#External_links

Thanks to: https://sketchfab.com/Dotflare for the original model: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/magnapinna-squid-be2b90cc7e2f436bb7a689a45aa256c1

name: Fossil brown bear (left pyramidal bone)
description:
3D scan of the left pyramidal bone of a  fossil brown bear (*Ursus arctos*). 


Fossil of a prime adult female skull of brown bear. The specimen was found in "Abisso Oriano Coltelli" cave (44°05'35,0 N, 10°14'47,0" E, labelled T/Lu 642 in the Tuscan register of caves) which opens at 1209 m a.s.l on the western slope of "Monte Alto di Sella" (Apuan Alps). The mammal assemblage collected consists of 486 investigated specimens, 127 of which belong to an individual skeleton of brown bear. The bear died from non-violent causes, probably during hibernation. The specimen was dated providing a conventional age of 6480 ± 40 14 C ka BP (Holocene).
More information : https://amq.aiqua.it/index.php/amq/article/view/112


Specimen: Brown bear, *Ursus arctos* Linnaeus, 1758

Inventory number: I17771

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Luca Pandolfi

name: indian cattle leech overview
description:
The Indian cattle leech (Hirudinaria granulosa) is a large freshwater annelid commonly found in ponds, lakes, and slow-moving waters across India and South Asia. It belongs to Phylum Annelida and Class Hirudinea.

This species is an ectoparasite, feeding on the blood of cattle and other vertebrates. The body is elongated, dorsoventrally flattened, and divided into segments. It possesses:

Anterior sucker – Used for attachment and feeding

Posterior sucker – Helps in locomotion and firm attachment

Muscular body wall – Enables looping movement

No setae (bristles) – Unlike other annelids

Leeches secrete hirudin, an anticoagulant that prevents blood clotting during feeding. Respiration occurs through the body surface.

This model is useful for studying annelid morphology, parasitic adaptations, and comparative invertebrate anatomy.

name: Black bear
description: The American black bear or simply black bear, is a species of medium-sized bear which is endemic to North America. It is the continent's smallest and most widely distributed bear species. It is an omnivore, with a diet varying greatly depending on season and location. It typically lives in largely forested areas; it will leave forests in search of food and is sometimes attracted to human communities due to the immediate availability of food. the American black bear as a least-concern species because of its widespread distribution and a large population, estimated to be twice that of all other bear species combined. Along with the brown bear (Ursus arctos), it is one of the two modern bear species not considered by the IUCN to be globally threatened with extinction.

name: Deer skull all round
description:
I'm not sure why this model looks so dark on Sketchfab.  Kiri Scan exported it as an OBJ file, even though I asked it to form a GLB file. Very strange.

I discovered that for some reason shading had been set on the model when exported to an OBJ file and uploaded onto sketchfab. I turned off shading, and the model looks well lit now.

Found this skull on a badger sett survey. Worked out a way to scan all round the skull using a cake decoration turntable.

name: Vulpes vulpes - MNCN2406
description:
**Description**: This 3D model represents the skull and jaws of a red fox. Although they are canids, foxes have evolutionary traits that bring them remarkably close to felines. In fact, they are the only canids with vertical pupils (like cats) for better night vision. Additionally, they can partially retract their claws and are expert tree climbers.

**Specimen**: *Vulpes vulpes*  (Linnaeus, 1758)

**Inventory number**: MNCN-M2406

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Mamíferos. Curator: Ángel Garvía (colecciondemamiferos@mncn.csic.es)

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/mamiferos).

Scanned with an Artec Spider in 2020 by Carlos A. Palancar.

It is one of only two extant species in the family Hippopotamidae, the other being the pygmy hippopotamus (Choeropsis liberiensis or Hexaprotodon liberiensis). Its name comes from the Ancient Greek for "river horse" (ἱπποπόταμος).

name: Brain of Nine-banded-armadillo
description:
*Dasypus novemcinctus* is a species of armadillo native to South America that is solitary, nocturnal and insectivore. They are extensive burrowers, with a single animal sometimes maintaining up to 12 burrows on its range. Armadillos mark their territory with urine, feces, and excretions from scent glands found on the eyelids, nose, and feet. They have a highly developed olfactory system.

This 3D model is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

Dissection: Bianca Rossi Cêspedes Paes

name: Brain of Striped Raphael Catfish
description:
Platydoras armatulus (Valenciennes 1840) is a fish species from the Doradidae family, Siluriformes order, found in the Paraná River basin in South America. It has a dark coloration and body structure adapted to riverbeds. Its main feature is the bony spines on its fins, which protect it from predators. This benthic species feeds on organic matter from the substrate and helps recycle nutrients in aquatic ecosystems. It is nocturnal and hides during the day, feeding at night.

This 3D model is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

Dissection: Ana Carolina Daldegan

name: Animated Human & T-Rex Hybrid (Humanosaurus Rex)
description:
The Humanosaurus Rex concept is inspired by early, unused hybrid creature ideas that were once rumored during the developmental stages of Jurassic World. In several abandoned design directions, scientists were imagined pushing genetic engineering beyond dinosaurs alone, attempting to merge human neurological patterns with prehistoric apex predators to create a controllable, hyper-adaptive super-specimen. Although this concept was ultimately never included in the final film and was replaced by other hybrid experiments, the idea represents one of the darker “what-if” branches of the Jurassic genetic universe. This 3D model brings that lost concept to life for the first time — visualizing a hybrid that could have existed in an alternate Jurassic timeline where evolution was no longer natural, but engineered. A creature designed not just to hunt, but to think, adapt, and dominate.

name: Exp. 37 Suspended
description: A modern (2024) male Red Deer (Cervus elaphus) right maxillary canine from Southern Germany. Perforated bifacially through scraping and drilling/boring with a handheld burin spall and endscraper (both of baltic chert) over 30 minutes and suspended sewn lingual to lingual vertically with red deer sinew for 90 hours. This is 1 of 60 teeth comprising an experimental reference collection for evaluating archaeological usewear stemming from the production and suspension of European Upper Paleolithic personal ornaments. This model was produced with an Artec Micro automated desktop 3D scanner at the University of Tubingen’s Material Culture Laboratory.

Trung vệ là vị trí chuyên biệt trong đội hình bóng đá, thường đặt ở giữa hàng phòng ngự của đội. Vị trí này có vai trò quan trọng trong việc giữ sự ổn định và an toàn cho hàng thủ của đội bóng. Dưới đây là một số điểm cụ thể về vai trò và nhiệm vụ của trung vệ trong bóng đá:
Xem thêm: **[Bongdawap](https://keonhacai.watch/bongdawap/)**
Vai Trò Của Trung Vệ
Phòng ngự chặt chẽ:

Trung vệ chủ yếu nhiệm vụ phòng ngự trong khu vực cấm của đội nhà, ngăn chặn các đòn tấn công từ đối phương. Họ cần có kỹ năng phán đoán tốt để can thiệp kịp thời và loại bỏ nguy cơ từ các đường chuyền hay cú sút của đối thủ.
Chuyền bóng và khởi xướng phản công:
Ngoài vai trò phòng ngự, trung vệ còn có nhiệm vụ chuyền bóng để khởi xướng các pha phản công của đội. Họ cần có khả năng điều phối bóng tốt để giao tiếp với các cầu thủ đồng đội ở phía trước, giúp đội bóng duy trì sự kiểm soát và tấn công hiệu quả.

3D scan of the skeleton of a vicuna (*Vicugna* sp.). 

The vicuna is one of the two wild South American camelids, which live in the high alpine areas of the Andes, from 3,200 to 4,800 m, the other being the guanaco, which lives at lower elevations. The length of head and body ranges from 1.45 to 1.60 m and its weight is from 35 to 65 kg. It feeds in daytime on the grassy plains of the Andes Mountains, but spend the nights on the slopes. In these areas, only nutrient-poor, tough, bunch grasses and *Festuca* grow.

description: The ear bone of a whale, known as the tympanic bulla, is one of the most distinctive and valuable parts of its skeleton for scientific study. description:
Modelos elaborados en el marco del trabajo de grado ***“Mundos plausibles y bioarquitecturas: Modelos de simulación para la coevolución entre sistemas ecológicos habitables”***, desarrollado como requisito para optar al título de Arquitecta en la Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, Facultad de Arquitectura y Diseño.

Estas bioarquitecturas fueron construidas en el entorno del *videojuego Minecraft y exportadas mediante la herramienta Mineways*, como parte de una metodología de simulación computacional orientada a explorar configuraciones espaciales adaptativas, ecosistémicamente sensibles y plausibles desde una perspectiva biocéntrica. Los modelos se utilizaron en procesos de simulación bioarquitectónica aplicados a mundos posibles, y forman parte del componente experimental de la investigación. name: Kirk's dik-dik
description:
3D scan of a stuffed Kirk's dik-dik (*Madoqua kirkii*). 

Kirk's dik-dik is a species of small dik-dik antelope native to Eastern and Southern Africa.
Dik-diks are some of the world's smallest antelopes, and the Kirk's dik-dik is the largest, standing between 35 and 45 cm tall and weighing no more than 7.2 kg. It is sexually dimorphic; females are larger and lack horns, while males sport a more developed muzzle, have a longer crest, and tend to be lighter in colour. It lives in the savannah areas of eastern and southwestern Africa, it is nocturnal and has and herbivorous diet that consists mainly of foliage, fruits, shoots, and berries.


Specimen: Kirk's dik-dik  *Madoqua kirkii* (Günther, 1880)

Inventory number: C 3296

name: generalized tuberculosis chicken
description:
Historical wax model showing systemic avian tuberculosis with miliary and conglomerate lesions in a chicken

size of specimen: 339.7 x 263.5 x 41.6 mm

Pathogenesis: After oral uptake of Mycobacterium avium subsp. avium, the pathogen penetrates the intestinal mucosa, spreads hematogenously, and causes granulomatous lesions in liver, spleen, bone marrow, and other organs.

Etiology: Infection via fecally contaminated soil or enclosures; highly persistent in the environment; commonly affects older birds in free-range systems.

Epidemiology: Rare in commercial flocks today; occasionally found in backyard poultry and zoos.

Clinical Features: Progressive emaciation despite good appetite, decreased productivity, lameness, nodular organ lesions (miliary or conglomerate) without prominent lung involvement.

Diagnostics: Histopathology, Ziehl-Neelsen staining, PCR or culture from organ samples.

name: Etruscan seal (15th thoracic vertebra)
description:
3D scan of the 15th thoracic vertebra of the Etruscan seal.

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: Three-toed sloth
description:
3D scan of the skull of a Three-toed sloth (*Bradypus* sp.).


The three-toed sloths are arboreal neotropical mammals, the only members of the genus Bradypus (meaning "slow-footed"), that inhabit tropical rainforests in northern South America. They are about the size of a small dog or a large cat, with the head and body having a combined length of around 45 cm and a weight of 3.5–4.5 kg. Unlike the two-toed sloths, they also have short tail of 6–7 cm, and three clawed toes on each limb. Three-toed sloths are predominantly diurnal, although they can be active at any hour of the day; They have an herbivorous diet, eating mostly leaves, buds, and twigs.

Specimen: Three-toed sloth, *Bradypus* sp.

name: African Elephant
description:
The African elephant is a majestic and massive creature, known as the largest land animal on Earth. It has a robust, gray body covered in tough, wrinkled skin that helps retain moisture and regulate body temperature. Its long, muscular trunk serves as a versatile tool for breathing, drinking, trumpeting, and grasping objects. Two large, curved ivory tusks extend from its upper jaw, used for defense, digging, and stripping bark from trees. The elephant's ears are enormous, shaped like the African continent, and they help dissipate heat in the hot savanna. Its pillar-like legs support its immense weight, allowing it to move gracefully despite its size. The African elephant exhibits high intelligence, strong social bonds, and a keen sense of memory, often traveling in herds led by a matriarch.

name: Cryolophosaurus V2
description: Cryolophosaurus was a large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Jurassic period, around 194 to 188 million years ago. Measuring up to 6.5 meters (21 feet) in length and weighing approximately 465 kilograms (1,025 pounds), it was distinguished by a unique crest on its head, which resembled an Elvis-like pompadour. This crest likely played a role in display and species recognition. Cryolophosaurus had a robust build with long legs, indicating it was a swift predator. Its fossils have been discovered in Antarctica, providing valuable insights into the diversity and adaptation of early theropods in polar environments.

name: Dusky grouper
description:
3D scan of the skull of a dusky grouper (*Epinephelus marginatus*). 

The dusky grouper is a species of marine ray-finned fish, which is part of the family Serranidae. It has two disjunct distribution centres, the main one is in the eastern Atlantic from the west coast of Iberia south along the western coast of Africa to the Cape of Good Hope, including Mediterranean,  the second one occurs in the south western Atlantic off the coast of South America. It can grow up to 150 cm in standard length but is more often 90 cm; it feeds on molluscs, crustaceans, and octopuses. 



Specimen: dusky grouper, *Epinephelus marginatus* (Lowe, 1834)

name: Black Myth: Wukong - Zhu Ba Jie (PigForm) [Anim]
description:
Zhu Ba Jie - Introduction

# Due to the limit of words, please translate the introduction below.

猪八戒，又名猪刚鬣、猪悟能，是古典名著《西游记》中的人物。

原是天庭玉皇大帝手下的天蓬元帅，主管天河，因醉酒调戏嫦娥，拱倒了斗牛宫，吃了王母灵芝菜，被玉皇大帝逐出天界，到人间投胎，却又错投猪胎，嘴脸与猪相似。下凡后“嫁”给卵二姐，栖身云栈洞，后被观音菩萨指点归于佛门，法号悟能，于高老庄等候取经人时入赘高太公家。唐僧西去取经路过高老庄，被孙悟空收服，拜唐僧为师。唐僧因猪八戒“老实”，平常多袒护猪八戒而责备孙悟空，猪八戒也好进谗言，多次挑唆唐僧与孙悟空的关系，导致唐僧两次将孙悟空赶走，直到“真假美猴王”之后，师徒之间才剪除二心，同心戮力，赶奔西天，遇到妖怪时，猪八戒开始敢于争先，成为孙悟空的好帮手，兄弟合力打败牛魔王、九头虫、豹子精、蟒蛇精等许多妖怪，虽然仍贪图美色，但定力较之前好了许多，打死玉面狐狸、万圣公主、杏仙等多个女妖。取得真经后，如来封猪八戒为“净坛使者”菩萨。

猪八戒身上既有人的吃苦耐劳、憨厚率直的品质以及贪婪自私的本性，又有神的本领，同时还有猪的形体特征，这充分体现了作者把人性、神性、猪性的完美结合。
